name: heaven-local-bridge
description: Multi-host local-control and development bridge for the user's heaven2 operator machine and heaven worker, with self-healing local watchdog persistence: explicit host-targeted filesystem, code build/test execution, persistent processes, screenshots, desktop/UI control, local agents, worker-fabric offloading, and control-plane operations.

interface.shortDescription: Control heaven2; delegate heavy work to heaven
interface.longDescription: Use the private Heaven Local Bridge as the multi-host computer-control path. heaven2 is the operator/control-plane desktop, dashboard host, browser/UI automation target, and credential authority; heaven is a delegated worker/resource machine for builds, tests, scans, agents, indexing, and worker-fabric jobs. Every new bridge job must set target_host explicitly. Interactive/control work targets heaven2; heavy delegated execution targets heaven. Omitted target_host remains a backward-compatibility default for heaven only. Structured filesystem/process, screenshots, UI Automation, coordinate input, windows, app launch, shortcuts, controller checkpoints, and credential-safe GUI secret input remain available according to each host's advertised health/capabilities. Worker persistence is guarded by an independent local watchdog and Git-independent heartbeat so a dead or hung bridge can recover without using the bridge to repair itself.
defaultPrompt: Use Heaven Local Bridge with target_host=heaven2 for this computer, desktop, dashboard, control-panel, browser, or UI interaction.
Use target_host=heaven for heavy builds, tests, scans, indexing, worker agents, or other delegated compute unless I explicitly ask to interact with heaven's desktop.
Keep Agent Control and all human-facing control surfaces on heaven2; treat heaven as a resource worker.
